findings.title: Public accounting cursor grammar differs from actual producer
findings.detail: Both boundaries permit only A-Za-z0-9_- while approved Controls391 persistent query emits 32hex:64hex:16hex, a114-character cursor containing colons. Any nonfinal real accounting page fails acceptance and its next request also fails. Labelled next-page/page_2 fixtures mask the mismatch.
findings.repair: Accept the actual closed producer grammar at both boundaries; consume a real persistent-index MAC cursor through initial page acceptance and subsequent fixed-origin fetch/private continuation. No broader URL/query allowance.

reviewedSoundBoundaries: Private owned_requests is read in8-ID pages with zero-padding/duplicate rejection and local-only owned IDs. Every public page is fetched regardless of owner matches, including an owner with no requests; partial scans return no totals.

Every page is bound to unchanged canonical PXE header and same public revision/checkpoint plus authenticated configured Bok instance identity. Missing owned entries, inconsistent money conservation/order/scope or stale anchors fail closed.

Free private credit, request allocations, reserved/charged and historical refunded values remain separate; refunded values are never added twice. Closed request history remains visible once new utility source is composed.

Cancel chooses owned WAITING/ACTIVE unreserved requests only; original private ABI simulation and reviewed fee path enforce actual contract eligibility. Uncertain submissions retain the existing encrypted no-replay workflow.

Bok exit retains exact amount, selected receiving Ethereum address, original nonce and resolved portal/token scope. It cannot spend reserved request balances; confirmed L2 exit blocks unrelated workflow replacement until canonical L1 refund is verified.

PluginPortal exit domain/ABI matches actual source. Exact successful L2 receipt and leaf membership plus canonical block/witness are rechecked, portal eth_call/estimate and gas cap precede explicit send, original token-scoped Ethereum journal records once and recovers read-only.

New Ethereum journal kind requires exact original calldata, recipient/amount/nonce event and canonical transaction identity; no event-only substitution. Testnet finality remains required. Wrong wallet, cancelled review, unknown/reforked outcomes cannot authorize another automatic send.
UI clears private balances/accounting on lock/account change, separates private fee and Ethereum gas, exposes incomplete accounting honestly, and leaves FEE redemption unsupported.

evidence.verified: All10 source bindings and all three receipt/log pairs match frozen candidate.326 ordinary and3 labelled Chromium checks passed; the pagination tests use labelled tokens and do not qualify producer composition.

limitations: No actual deployed new owned_requests class, live uniform page acquisition, canonical private cancellation/withdrawal or settled Portal refund acceptance.
Normal SDK/wallet and Controls391/882 source composition remain necessary.
One blocking source defect sent directly to Design and parent; coherent successor review pending.
